items.question: Client supplied all three concept notes on 1 November. Branded two-page PDFs and email-only download simulator are available. Backend storage is explicitly deferred by the user.
Supply final wording, URL, processing/retention purposes and consent requirements. Preview uses notices and an unchecked general-enquiry acknowledgement; no personal data is sent.
Confirm the nine proposed public labels and stable backend identifiers. All practice fields are optional and start empty; preview labels follow the designer list.

Designer uses Strategy Consultant on the expert page and Management Consultant on the client page; portal approval says Consultant. Preview retains Consultant consistently. Confirm the final public labels and mapping before production.

The Feedback 1 calculator includes 3–4 years and an illustrative Associate starting level, as supplied by the client. Confirm the corresponding application route/eligibility policy: approved short-application bands still begin at five years. Do not change private CTQ or falsely classify candidates.
Confirm real endpoints, durable receipt schema, queue owners, server validation/recomputation, idempotent retry and safe response contracts. Static preview never claims receipt.

Confirm exact introduction gates, non-circumvention terms and affected fee/non-exclusivity claims. Preview uses private matching and approved-process wording, no promises about fees or guaranteed work.
